description: This file defines the ModuleNotAvailableSubscriber class, a Symfony event subscriber that intercepts HTTP requests to handle disabled modules by forwarding or forbidding access.

classes.name: ModuleNotAvailableSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber that checks if a requested module is disabled and handles request forwarding or access denial accordingly.

methods.name: getModuleService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the ModuleService instance used to retrieve disabled modules.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the kernel request event.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles the request event; checks if the module in the request path is disabled and throws exceptions to forward or block access.
